subject: Chemistry
unit: Unit IV — Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
title: Molecular Orbital Theory (MOT): LCAO, s-p Mixing, Bond Order & Magnetism
topics: s-p Mixing for Z ≤ 7 (N₂, C₂, B₂) vs Z > 7 (O₂, F₂)
Oxygen Series (O₂⁺, O₂, O₂⁻, O₂²⁻) & Paramagnetism
Nitrogen Series (N₂, N₂⁺, N₂⁻) & Heteronuclear CO⁺ Anomaly
quickSummary: MOT treats electrons as delocalized in molecular orbitals formed by LCAO. For Z ≤ 7 (N₂), s-p mixing pushes σ 2p_z above π 2p_x,y. Bond order BO = (N_b - N_a)/2 governs stability, bond length, and paramagnetism.
summary: Master MOT energy level ordering, s-p mixing, bond order calculations, and the oxygen/nitrogen diatomic series.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 7.1 LCAO & s-p Mixing Energy Ordering
conceptBreakdown.title: 7.1 LCAO & s-p Mixing Energy Ordering

summaryBox.title: MOT Energy Levels
summaryBox.takeaway: Z ≤ 7 (N₂): π 2p_x,y < σ 2p_z (s-p mixing). Z > 7 (O₂): σ 2p_z < π 2p_x,y (no mixing). BO = (N_b - N_a)/2.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
MO ENERGY LEVEL ORDERING COMPARISON
                   
   FOR Z ≤ 7 (Li₂, B₂, C₂, N₂):  [s-p Mixing PRESENT]
   σ1s < σ*1s < σ2s < σ*2s < (π2p_x = π2p_y) < σ2p_z < (π*2p_x = π*2p_y) < σ*2p_z
   
   FOR Z > 7 (O₂, F₂, Ne₂):      [NO s-p Mixing]
   σ1s < σ*1s < σ2s < σ*2s < σ2p_z < (π2p_x = π2p_y) < (π*2p_x = π*2p_y) < σ*2p_z
conceptBreakdown.content: • In light homonuclear diatomics ($Z \le 7$), small $2s-2p$ energy gap causes $s-p$ mixing, pushing $\sigma 2p_z$ above $\pi 2p_{x,y}$.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 7.2 Oxygen & Nitrogen Species Series Comparison
conceptBreakdown.title: 7.2 Oxygen & Nitrogen Species Series Comparison
conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **Oxygen Family Series**:
• $\mathbf{\text{O}_2^+} (15\ e^-)$: $BO = \mathbf{2.5}$, Paramagnetic (1 unpaired $e^-$)
• $\mathbf{\text{O}_2} (16\ e^-)$: $BO = \mathbf{2.0}$, **Paramagnetic (2 unpaired $e^-$ in $\pi^* 2p$)**
• $\mathbf{\text{O}_2^-} (17\ e^-)$: $BO = \mathbf{1.5}$, Paramagnetic (1 unpaired $e^-$)
• $\mathbf{\text{O}_2^{2-}} (18\ e^-)$: $BO = \mathbf{1.0}$, Diamagnetic
$$\mathbf{\text{Stability / Bond Energy: } \text{O}_2^+ > \text{O}_2 > \text{O}_2^- > \text{O}_2^{2-}}$$
$$\mathbf{\text{Bond Length: } \text{O}_2^{2-} > \text{O}_2^- > \text{O}_2 > \text{O}_2^+}$$

2. **Nitrogen Family Series**:
• $\mathbf{\text{N}_2} (14\ e^-)$: $BO = \mathbf{3.0}$, Diamagnetic (Highest homonuclear $BO$)
• $\mathbf{\text{N}_2^+} (13\ e^-)$: $BO = \mathbf{2.5}$, Paramagnetic (unpaired $e^-$ in bonding $\sigma 2p_z$)
• $\mathbf{\text{N}_2^-} (15\ e^-)$: $BO = \mathbf{2.5}$, Paramagnetic (unpaired $e^-$ in antibonding $\pi^* 2p$)

• **Heteronuclear Exception ($\text{CO}^+$)**: Removing an electron from slightly antibonding $\sigma 2s^*$ increases the bond order: $\mathbf{BO(\text{CO}^+) = 3.5}$ vs $BO(\text{CO}) = 3.0$.

quickRevision: O₂ is Paramagnetic with 2 unpaired electrons in π* 2p.
